# Kaushal Raj Gupta

## Full Stack Developer & Cybersecurity Enthusiast

I'm Kaushal Raj Gupta, a developer based in India building useful web applications, AI tools, and community experiences. I combine full-stack development with a growing focus on cybersecurity and security operations.

## Education

B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering, Siksha 'O' Anusandhan University — Institute of Technical Education and Research (ITER). 2024–2028, in progress.

## Selected projects

### CampusConnect

A college companion that brings timetables, attendance tracking, student discussions, faculty information, and campus clubs into one dashboard. Built with role-based access and Google sign-in.

Built with: React, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Firebase.

[Source code](https://github.com/Kaushall44/Connect) · [Live demo](https://connect-liard-five.vercel.app)

### SOA Nexus AI

An institutional service-delivery prototype built with my team for SOA IDEATHON 2026. It explores AI-assisted lab reservations, certificates, maintenance requests, and approval workflows, with a standalone demo mode and an optional live backend.

Built with: React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, Supabase, Tailwind CSS.

[Source code](https://github.com/Kaushall44/Veyon-AI) · [Live demo](https://veyon-ai-alpha.vercel.app)

### Email Style Adjuster

A visual workspace for styling HTML emails. Adjust CSS, see a live preview, and export the resulting email markup through a responsive React interface.

Built with: React, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite.

[Source code](https://github.com/Kaushall44/Email-Style-Adjuster) · [Live demo](https://kaushall44.github.io/Email-Style-Adjuster/)

### Kaushal Movies

A responsive, region-aware directory for discovering movie, television, anime, and streaming services. Includes instant catalog search, category filters, and light and dark themes.

Built with: React, JavaScript, CSS, Vite, Fuse.js.

[Source code](https://github.com/Kaushall44/kaushal-movies) · [Live demo](https://kaushal-movies.vercel.app)

### Terminal Portfolio

A personal portfolio presented through a hacker-inspired terminal interface. An exploration of how a familiar developer environment can become an interactive introduction.

Built with: HTML, CSS, JavaScript.

[Source code](https://github.com/Kaushall44/kaushall44.github.io) · [Live demo](https://kaushall44.github.io/)

### Groq AI Backend

An Express backend connected to the Groq API for terminal-based code generation. Includes a command-line client, formatted responses, and support for downloading generated code files.

Built with: Node.js, Express, JavaScript, Groq API, Vercel.

[Source code](https://github.com/Kaushall44/Kaushal-ITER)

### VS Code Portfolio

A developer portfolio styled like Visual Studio Code, featuring a simulated terminal, command palette, and theme toggle. Built to make exploring projects feel familiar to developers.

Built with: React, TypeScript, Vite, CSS.

[Source code](https://github.com/Kaushall44/vs-code-theme-portfolio) · [Live demo](https://kaushall44.github.io/vs-code-theme-portfolio/)
